summary: Backend + UI smoke test of BFPO/MOD Engineer Portal. Wrote 19 pytest cases covering login (portal:mod), engineer territory scoping isolation, cross-territory 404, role-guard 403 on /staff/*, guided workflow (accept->arrive->diagnose->signature->complete + PDF), parts flow, equipment-unsafe outcome, report-fault duplicate warning, staff dashboard KPIs, sites tree with critical health for MPC & HMS Rooke, staff jobs filters, allocation with handover, visiting-access grant/list/revoke expanding engineer scope. All 19 backend tests PASS. UI smoke: engineer login, KPI tiles, sites nav, staff dashboard, sites tree, jobs, visiting-access all render correctly.

minor.issue: Seed did not purge db.bfpo_visiting_access on re-seed, so stale grants from earlier curl testing leaked cross-territory sites/jobs into engineer scope. FIXED by adding delete_many on bfpo_visiting_access to seed.

integration_issues.issue: staff-jobs default filter loaded 0 rows in smoke run — likely defaults to a filter with no matches; consider defaulting to status=open. Not blocking; endpoint returns rows when filter=open.

action_items: Consider defaulting Staff Jobs UI filter to status=open so rows show without user interaction.
Login response returns 'token' (not 'access_token'). If future tests / integrations expect access_token, standardise.
critical_code_review_comments: Scoping enforcement in /api/bfpo/routes.py is correctly server-side via _scoped_case_query/_visible_site_ids — verified in tests.
Sensitive site fields (access_instructions, security_notes) correctly stripped for engineer role, retained for lead/staff.
State machine paths for parts (paused_parts) and complete (on_site -> awaiting_sign_off -> closed) work as designed.
Seed idempotency: previous version left stale bfpo_visiting_access; now purged. Confirm this doesn't remove production data (BFPO_ORG_ID scoped so safe).
test_credentials: See /app/memory/test_credentials_bfpo.md. engineer.gib / engineer.cyp / lead / staff @bfpo.pulsefitness.test all with Bfpo123!, portal:mod
seed_data_creation: Re-seeded demo data via `cd /app/backend && python -m scripts.seed_bfpo` at start and end. Added bfpo_visiting_access purge to seed script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_bfpo_portal_jan2026.py (19 tests). Run seed before tests. Login response key is 'token' not 'access_token'. Staff jobs default UI filter shows 0 rows — minor UX suggestion, not a bug.
rca of the issue: First run of scoping tests failed because bfpo_visiting_access from previous manual curl testing persisted (Gib engineer had active grant to Falklands site). Root cause: seed_bfpo.py wiped svc_cases/events/counters/parts_requests but not visiting_access grants. Fix: add delete_many for bfpo_visiting_access in seed. Tests then pass 19/19.
